{"id":1588014297,"question_id":2888,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1743073336,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"63 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1588014297/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Index of a Valid Split","memory":"103 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumIndex(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        unordered_map<int,int>left;\n        unordered_map<int,int>right;\n\n        for(auto &x : nums)\n        {\n            right[x]++;\n        }\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            left[nums[i]]++;\n            right[nums[i]]--;\n\n            int n1 = i+1;\n            int n2 = n-i-1;\n\n            if(left[nums[i]] > n1/2 && right[nums[i]] > n2/2)\n            {\n                return i;\n            }\n        }\n    return -1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-index-of-a-valid-split","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":500}
